description: Verbatim copy of the Mozilla server-side TLS guidelines, version 6.0, as published by TLSref. Never edit the fixture by hand: refresh it from the source URL and update this file in the same commit.

mirror.note: Serves the same guidelines version. On 2026-11-22 its configurations.intermediate object was identical to the fixture's; only the document's own href and its formatting differed, so its checksum differs.

selectedFields.ciphersuites: Expected TLS 1.3 cipher suites. nginx keeps the OpenSSL default, so only the handshake is checked.

intentionalDeviations.hsts_min_age: ADR 0004 sends max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains, not the guideline's 63072000.
intentionalDeviations.ocsp_staple: ADR 0004 does not staple: Let's Encrypt stopped running OCSP responders in 2025.

unselectedFields: Every other field (certificate_*, dh_param_size, ecdh_param_size, rsa_key_size, oldest_clients, lifespans, ciphers.iana) describes certificates, clients or the DHE parameters of suites the profile does not enable, and the Ingress does not enforce it.
